en.aboutPurposeDesc: Make the record easier to examine
en.aboutPurposeText: The project is designed as a chronological research desk. It helps readers trace a claim from a timeline entry to a notification, a hearing notice, a policy source, or a court record without treating summaries as a substitute for the original document.
en.aboutScopeText: The bundle covers the statutory framework, State OBC-list changes, reservation and roster records, the 2025–26 notification sequence, public hearings, and a growing litigation tracker. It does not claim to be a complete government archive.
en.aboutUseText: Some records are text-extracted or copied from publicly accessible mirrors. Court status, operative directions, and notification validity should always be confirmed from the issuing authority or the relevant court.
en.aboutSourcePrinciple: Source principle: where this site summarizes a record, open the linked document and treat the primary source as controlling. The project does not endorse any political position or make findings about any community.
en.obcBasicsText1: "Other Backward Classes" refers to communities or classes identified as socially and educationally backward and inadequately represented. In practice, state lists use caste, sub-caste, occupation, community, conversion history, and social location as evidence markers, but the legal category is backward class.
en.obcBasicsTitle2: "Muslims have no caste, so they cannot be OBC"
en.obcBasicsText2: That is too simple. Islam as a faith does not prescribe caste, but South Asian Muslim society has long had socially ranked occupational and descent communities. Groups such as Jolah/Ansari-Momin, Fakir/Sain, Nashya-Sekh, Pahadia Muslim, Rayeen/Kunjra, Hajjam, and Chowduli appear in West Bengal OBC records because the class or community was treated as backward, not because reservation was given to all Muslims.
en.obcBasicsText3: The useful question is not whether a whole religion has caste. The useful question is whether a particular class has evidence of social and educational backwardness, inadequate representation, and proper process through the Commission, survey, hearing, or notification route. This page keeps those source trails visible.
en.methodsText1: The correct unit is not an entire religion or a vague surname group. It is the specific caste, sub-caste, occupational community, converted community, or locally known class whose disadvantage can be measured. West Bengal records show this logic: entries such as Bhangi (Muslim), Sekh/Seikh, Kazi/Kaji/Quazi/Quaji (Muslim), and SBCW-165 Category-B serial 97 are document-specific, not blanket religious reservation.
en.methodsTitle2: Use multiple indicators, not one slogan
en.methodsText2: The Mandal framework grouped indicators into social, educational, and economic heads and used a weighted score. That is the right spirit: no single number proves backwardness by itself. A robust method checks school completion, literacy, dropout, landholding, occupation, housing, income, social stigma, manual or hereditary work, and exclusion from public posts.
en.methodsText3: Backwardness is incomplete without representation data. Departments should publish class-wise and category-wise counts in recruitment, promotions where relevant, educational admissions, scholarships, hostels, certificate issuance, and pending vacancies. Without this, the public cannot test whether a class is under-represented or whether benefits are being captured by better-placed groups.
en.methodsText4: If a class has no reliable population estimate, every percentage argument becomes guesswork. The 2012 panchayat survey documents in this bundle show the practical problem: officials were instructed to enumerate households, carry the backward-class list, publish draft lists, and process claims and objections. That kind of procedure is the beginning of auditable data.
en.methodsText5: Departments should publish annual tables showing how many people from each OBC category and, where legally and administratively possible, each listed class are present in services and admissions. This is how one can distinguish genuine inadequate representation from a merely loud demand.
en.methodsText6: Reservation should be checked against outcomes: who received certificates, who applied, who was selected, who remained excluded, which districts lagged, and whether the creamy layer is filtering better-off households. Good data protects deserving groups and exposes misuse.

bn.aboutPurposeText: প্রকল্পটিকে chronological research desk হিসেবে design করা হয়েছে। এটি readers-কে help করে একটি claim-কে timeline entry থেকে notification, hearing notice, policy source, বা court record পর্যন্ত trace করতে, summaries-কে original document-এর substitute হিসেবে treat না করে।
bn.aboutScopeText: bundle covers করে statutory framework, State OBC-list changes, reservation এবং roster records, 2025–26 notification sequence, public hearings, এবং একটি growing litigation tracker। এটি complete government archive দাবি করে না।
bn.aboutUseText: কিছু records text-extracted বা publicly accessible mirrors থেকে copied। Court status, operative directions, এবং notification validity সবসময় issuing authority বা relevant court থেকে confirm করা উচিত।
bn.aboutSourcePrinciple: Source principle: যেখানে এই site একটি record summarize করে, linked document open করুন এবং primary source-কে controlling হিসেবে treat করুন। প্রকল্পটি কোনো political position endorse করে না বা কোনো community সম্পর্কে findings make করে না।
bn.obcBasicsText1: "Other Backward Classes" বলতে সেইসব communities বা classes-কে বোঝায় যাদের socially এবং educationally backward এবং inadequately represented হিসেবে identify করা হয়েছে। Practice-এ, state lists use করে caste, sub-caste, occupation, community, conversion history, এবং social location-কে evidence markers হিসেবে, কিন্তু legal category হলো backward class।
bn.obcBasicsTitle2: "Muslims have no caste, so they cannot be OBC"
bn.obcBasicsText2: এটা too simple। Islam as a faith caste prescribe করে না, কিন্তু South Asian Muslim society-তে দীর্ঘদিন ধরে socially ranked occupational এবং descent communities আছে। Jolah/Ansari-Momin, Fakir/Sain, Nashya-Sekh, Pahadia Muslim, Rayeen/Kunjra, Hajjam, এবং Chowduli-র মতো groups West Bengal OBC records-এ appear করে কারণ class বা community-কে backward হিসেবে treat করা হয়েছিল,不是因为 সকল Muslims-কে reservation দেওয়া হয়েছিল।
bn.obcBasicsText3: useful question হলো না যে একটি পুরো religion-এর caste আছে কিনা। useful question হলো যে একটি particular class-এর social এবং educational backwardness, inadequate representation, এবং Commission, survey, hearing, বা notification route-এর মাধ্যমে proper process-এর evidence আছে কিনা। এই page সেই source trails-কে visible রাখে।
bn.methodsText1: correct unit হলো না একটি পুরো religion বা একটি vague surname group। এটি হলো specific caste, sub-caste, occupational community, converted community, বা locally known class যার disadvantage measure করা যায়। West Bengal records এই logic দেখায়: entries যেমন Bhangi (Muslim), Sekh/Seikh, Kazi/Kaji/Quazi/Quaji (Muslim), এবং SBCW-165 Category-B serial 97 হলো document-specific, blanket religious reservation নয়।
bn.methodsTitle2: Use multiple indicators, not one slogan
bn.methodsText2: Mandal framework indicators-কে social, educational, এবং economic heads-এ group করেছিল এবং weighted score use করেছিল। সেটাই right spirit: কোনো single number নিজে নিজে backwardness prove করে না। একটি robust method check করে school completion, literacy, dropout, landholding, occupation, housing, income, social stigma, manual বা hereditary work, এবং public posts থেকে exclusion।
bn.methodsText3: representation data ছাড়া backwardness incomplete। Departments-এর class-wise এবং category-wise counts publish করা উচিত recruitment-এ, promotions-এ (যেখানে relevant), educational admissions-এ, scholarships-এ, hostels-এ, certificate issuance-এ, এবং pending vacancies-এ। এটা ছাড়া, public test করতে পারে না যে একটি class under-represented কিনা অথবা benefits better-placed groups দ্বারা capture হচ্ছে কিনা।
bn.methodsText4: যদি একটি class-এর reliable population estimate না থাকে, প্রতিটি percentage argument guesswork হয়ে যায়। এই bundle-এ 2012 panchayat survey documents practical problem দেখায়: officials-কে instruction দেওয়া হয়েছিল households enumerate করতে, backward-class list carry করতে, draft lists publish করতে, এবং claims এবং objections process করতে। সেই ধরনের procedure হলো auditable data-র beginning।
bn.methodsText5: Departments-এর annual tables publish করা উচিত যে দেখায় কতজন মানুষ প্রতিটি OBC category থেকে এবং, যেখানে legally এবং administratively possible, প্রতিটি listed class থেকে services এবং admissions-এ present। এভাবেই one can distinguish genuine inadequate representation থেকে একটি merely loud demand।
bn.methodsText6: Reservation-কে outcomes-এর বিরুদ্ধে check করা উচিত: কে certificates পেয়েছে, কে apply করেছে, কে selected হয়েছে, কে excluded থেকে গেছে, কোন districts lagged করেছে, এবং creamy layer better-off households-কে filter করছে কিনা। Good data deserving groups-কে protect করে এবং misuse expose করে।
bn.timelineNote: Reading note: green items local documents-এ latest position দেখায়। Red items Notification No. 944-BCW/MR-23/2026 দ্বারা expressly withdrawn হয়েছে। Amber items হল scanned PDFs; scanned item-এর details শুধুমাত্র source PDF থেকে text-extracted অংশ পর্যন্ত সীমিত।
bn.casesSectionSub: এই tracker টি order-এ যা actually record করা হয়েছে তা পরবর্তী policy action থেকে আলাদা করে। এটি একটি research index, legal advice নয়; rely করার আগে অবশ্যই relevant court থেকে case status check করতে হবে।
bn.employeeProtectionKicker: Litigation support note · এটি official order নয়
bn.employeeProtectionSub: একটি user-supplied bilingual note-এ argue করা হয়েছে যে bona fide employees যারা government-issued এবং verified OBC certificate-এ appoint হয়েছেন, তাদের blanket termination হওয়া উচিত নয় শুধুমাত্র এই কারণে যে reservation policy বা class-list process পরে invalidated হয়েছে। এটিকে argument map হিসেবে treat করুন: ব্যবহার করার আগে প্রতিটি citation actual judgment-এর against verify করুন।
bn.frameworkSectionSub: যখনই নতুন PDF, court order, hearing notice, report, বা missing source add করা হয়, এই structure use করুন। লক্ষ্য হলো প্রতিটি entry কে searchable, source-linked, এবং auditable রাখা।
bn.frameworkCard2Title: 2. Complete mark করার আগে evidence checks
bn.evidenceSectionSub: Local folders-এ core 2010, 2025, এবং 2026 notifications, hearing notices, এবং litigation records আছে। এই table টি দেখায় কী present, কী partial, এবং কী locate করা বাকি।
